capabilities: : Converts markdown tables into financial dashboards
: Tracks net monthly spend and trends
extras: The Money Map page downloads map tiles from tile.openstreetmap.org. The plugin makes no other network requests and collects no telemetry.
problem: It addresses the need to track and visualize personal spending, billing cycles, and financial trends using only markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Two Apple Shortcuts turn a bank SMS into an inbox row.
Log Transaction from Share Sheet uses the ChatGPT extension of Apple Intelligence.

summary: Converts a plain markdown transaction inbox into three dashboards: net spend, billing cycle details, and a spending heatmap.
